name: VRSim Training
summary:
VRSim Training turns your Meta Quest into a corporate VR training station for workplace safety and soft skills.

Sign in by entering the **6-digit pairing code** from your operator's dashboard at https://vrsim.training/ — no cables, no complex setup. Your instructor launches scenarios on your headset and guides the session live, seeing what you see in real time.

**What you can train**
- Fire response, first aid, and warehouse & office safety
- AI voice role-play — talk to interactive AI characters to pract
